A tabKey that is not details/master_qcs/a stage uuid renders nothing — src/views/projectDetails/projectDetails.jsx:1018-1022

Contact Info: buyer display name, email, phone; info icon with "Ownership changed on <DATE>" previous/new owner when `ownerTrail` exists — src/views/projectDetails/projectDetails.jsx:295-310, 853-915

GET `/reminders/:projectId?resource_type=event_group` lists reminder cards with "<total_count> Pending" — src/views/projectDetails/query.js:4-10, src/models/project/projectService.js:287-288, src/views/projectDetails/components/bulkReminderDrawer.jsx:193-217

the project card routes the same draft stage with `draftStageIds` and only for auction-team users, this table with `draftEventId` for anyone — src/views/projectDetails/components/publishedStagesTable.jsx:16-25 vs src/views/orders/components/projectCard/projectCard.jsx:170-187

Success → "Project withdrawn successfully" and project details refetched — src/views/projectDetails/components/withdrawProjectModal.jsx:33-38

Clone: POST `/event_groups/:id/create_clone` (no body); success "Project cloned successfully" → `/project/<event_group_uuid>/details`; modal says "Cloning is supported only for the Technical and RFQ stages." — src/views/projectDetails/components/cloneProjectModal.jsx:17-53, src/models/project/projec

Please try again."; failed status shows its message as an alert — src/views/projectDetails/components/lineI

`PATCH /event_groups/:id` `{status:"withdrawn", withdraw_remark:{remarks, attachments:[]}}`; success "Draft project withdrawn successfully" and redirect `/orders?tab=live` — withdrawDraftProjectModal.jsx:17-31, src/views/projectDetails/components/mutation.js:34-49, src/views/projectCreation/projectC

Communication hub (chat) hidden while the project is draft or when communication is not allowed — src/views/projectDetails/projectDetails.jsx:1056-1063

POST `/reminders/:id/send_reminder` `{resource_type:"event_group", reminder_type, reminders:{recipient_uuid:[uuids]}}`; toast "Reminders Sent to N Vendor(s)/Evaluator(s)/Approver(s)" — src/views/projectDetails/mutation.js:45-75

cases.title: Published stages show the correct columns and fallback values
steps: Inspect the stage table headers and row values.
cases.expected: "Stage Code" is not shown. The table shows "Stage Title", "Pending Actions", "Participants", "Bidding Starts At", and "Bidding Ends At". A missing participant count displays as "0". Missing bidding dates display as "-".
cases.setup: Use a project whose stages have no ref_id on any row, one stage with no participant count, and missing bidding dates.
gaps: Cannot customize the prepared state event to have stages without ref_id
Cannot force missing bidding dates or participant counts to test fallback display ('-' and '0')
